R001.text: Set up the meal and mix her food.
R001.source: R001 Margaret Ellis, Food and fluids

R001.text: Offer the toilet before bed. Night light on, walker beside the bed, call bell in reach.
R001.source: R001 Margaret Ellis, Falls and mobility

R001.text: Night round: offer the toilet and check the call bell is in reach.
R001.source: R001 Margaret Ellis, Falls and mobility

R002.text: Full help with the meal. Small spoonfuls. Check the mouth is empty.
R002.source: R002 Harold Brennan, Food and fluids

R002.text: Check the sensor mat is on. Check bed rails as per the care plan.
R002.source: R002 Harold Brennan, Falls and mobility

R003.text: Check the meal is peanut-free. Help open packets and containers.
R003.source: R003 Dorothy Nguyen, Food and fluids

R004.text: Check both hearing aids are in.
Offer the toilet after the meal.

R005.text: Supervise the meal. Sit fully upright. Small sips. Watch for coughing or a wet voice.
R005.source: R005 Eileen Murray, Food and fluids

R005.text: Keep her upright for 30 minutes after the meal.
R005.source: R005 Eileen Murray, Food and fluids

R005.text: Check the sensor mat is on.
R005.source: R005 Eileen Murray, Falls and mobility

R006.text: Set up and cut his food. Check it is lactose-free.
R006.source: R006 Walter Kowalski, Food and fluids

R007.text: Give a large-print menu. Carbohydrate-controlled meal.
R007.source: R007 Ruth Abernathy, Food and fluids

R008.text: Prompt and supervise the meal. Soft and bite-sized (Level 6), slightly thick fluids (Level 1).
R008.source: R008 Frank Delaney, Food and fluids

R009.source: R009 Priya Venkatesan, Food and fluids

R010.text: Reposition. Check heels and lower back. Look for signs of pain.
R010.source: R010 Colin Whitfield, Falls and mobility

R010.text: Check the hearing aid battery (right ear).
Full feeding help. Sit upright. Slow, small spoonfuls. Check the mouth is empty before the next one.
R010.source: R010 Colin Whitfield, Food and fluids

R010.text: Check the bed is low and the sensor mat is on.
R010.source: R010 Colin Whitfield, Falls and mobility
